title: The AGHF Trade Journal

launchpad.outcome: Log a rep through the five-part journal, pre-filled from replay.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What does a useful journal entry look like?

slides.title: Five parts. A few minutes.
lines: Any source: case, backtest, replay, paper, live or manual. Log trades, passes and missed opportunities.
cards: Instrument, session, direction, size, entry, stop, target, outcome, R
4H thesis, 1H structure, PIL, ICC validity, quality, environment
What worked, what didn’t, violations, one lesson

slides.title: Log a rep from replay
lines: What the Academy already knows is filled in. You review. You don’t retype.

takeaways: If the data exists, it’s reused.
Trades, passes and misses all belong in the journal.
remember: The breakdown is the journal entry.
